parsed.scene_description: An indoor library or study area with tall wooden bookshelves lining the left wall and a multi-tiered spiral illuminated display structure in the center. Several people are seated at desks along the back wall under arched alcoves. Orange chairs are arranged in the foreground around tables. A person stands on the right side of the frame holding an object.

objects.label: bookshelf
objects.observation: Tall wooden shelving unit with multiple rows of books and illuminated sections, located along the left wall extending from foreground to background.

objects.label: spiral display unit
objects.observation: Multi-level circular shelving structure with integrated lighting, positioned centrally in the room. Books are visible on its tiers.

objects.label: orange chair
objects.observation: Curved back orange upholstered chair located in the foreground. Multiple instances visible around tables.

objects.label: person standing
objects.observation: Individual wearing glasses and white hoodie with graphics, standing on the right side of the frame. Holding a dark object.

objects.label: desk alcove
objects.observation: Arched recessed area in wooden wall containing a desk surface and small light fixture. Located along the back wall.
